I was not impressed with the service at this hospital. The doctor examined my stitched wound without gloves and without (visibly, in my opinion) disinfecting his hands. While this may not be medically relevant, it certainly isn't standard practice, given my numerous doctor's visits in the past seven days. Furthermore, the doctor's diagnosis differed significantly from the opinions of two other doctors we had consulted in the previous 24 hours.

On a positive note, the doctor indirectly admitted his uncertainty and referred us to a specialist in Hua Hin. However, since it was a minor issue and not a complicated illness or anything like that, the service was simply poor and disappointing for a hospital. Hence, only three stars.
